name: enchanter
text: enchanter is an English term that in MacKillop appears as a one-line cross-reference. The reference points the reader to two Welsh wizard types: dyn hysbys and eiddiliggor. The dyn hysbys article sits in this same N7 batch as the primary Welsh wizard entry. The eiddiliggor target lies outside the present GAF-288 scope and is not followed here.
